book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yoan lipekeing lukanzek
Lek bouk kayon eno Herot seyap tiwei tax o ngo qayeeng en Yesu,
om neil wou e xe xel xukxe bei, “Tambiy tine inye Yoan lipekeing. Moxo qandi veil meyeing! Qes tiyon om qou nikanzek me di wong lulvako tine.”
Takwei eno Herot zeimaxoun Yoan me tup e dom toung e eivek xeitueing en Herodias, li Pilip venei,
en nambei Yoan neil wou moxo, “Inye se nimza bei wa qou lim Pilip venei.”
Herot embei nyeis Yoan, ekom moxo yaleeng en xel xomaxoneing on, en inye xel wou kwend bei tambiy on poropet ti.
Lek Herot xe bouk wei umbek lek eno lam om Herodias neu vexawo yon lam aw om Herot wo xeilala me lalei vind vexo,
om wong qayeeng neing is nikanzek wou vexo bei tyek bong vati wei embei teling eno wou e.
Lek ta xe woueing nalei, vexo neil, “Wang bong Yoan lipekeing lukanzek wou ay lek dipekta ne.”
King moxo lalei wo nimaying, ekom e xe qayeeng wei neil zonghek is vexo me e xe xel wei lam en yaeing o, om moxo neil wou e xe xel bei vexo xe telinyeing embo neing lek
om wong xel la qateiv Yoan kwa tip eivek xomek xeitueing.
Moxo lukanzek eno xel toung lek dipekta me qou me la wong wou vexawo yon, de vexo qou me la wong wou ta.
Yoan xe xel betiyeing lam me qou e neing me la ev. Woyom xel la neil wou Yesu.
Yesu vet moux 5,000
Yesu ngo vati wei belup on, moxo la veil beyeeng me la lek bot me la ingwei xel ma veil o. Xel qendu ngandoung on ngo tine me betiy e me la vaxend nanghei beyeeng nayak ngenong on.
Yesu teila me yei xel qendu ngandoung on, moxo lalei pyaxow en xel om wong xel xe vanei wo nimzalek.

Ka ingwei di souk o, xel betiyeing lam me neil wou e, “Beyeeng bandaing tine xel ma veil, de moxo di bouk tiyo inye mouyo. Wong xel qendu ngandoung on la, en kandek xel na beyeeng nei me na bou xend yaeing valu yo.”
Yesu neil elox, “Xel na enva? Xam ghe bong lul yaeing valu wou xel en xel gya.”
Xel neil wou e, “Yaing ngenong ma veil xa yo, inye belet lim de woing yuw xemou.”
Moxo neil, “Xam qou dalus me lam inye wou ay.”

De moxo neil wou xomaxoneing on bei xel mendei tembuing lek lesilek on. Moxo qou belet lim on me qou woing yuw on is dom yeila tyoung gheyapu nei, me wo dange wou dom dembu. Woyom wong wou e xe xel betiyeing, me xel betiyeing wong wou xel xomaxoneing on.
Xel dalus on ya me enden xel, de xel betiyeing qekuwou myapapu wei xel se ya yo eivek pasik xoumeeng yuw.
Xel moux wei ya yaeing on teyei lek 5,000. Xel se pyaw memend wou xel vex alis neundyeiw.
Yesu di la lek lounyeing
Lutika eno Yesu wong xel betiyeing la eivek bot me la tax en e me la nge loxalu, dekakom wong xel qendu ngandoung on la.
Ka ingwei wong xel on la woy, moxo venaxow lek la lukendu bei na zeimema. Gyeik ingwei boukeing di lam eno e maxow toundei inyon,
ekom bot vena la dingta takwei nei veil tembuing, me laweeng vei mamileeng vuk me lam leislek bot is xel.
Ka embim boyaing eno Yesu di la wou xel, me la lek lounyeing mapu.
Xel betiyeing yei moxo di la lek lounyeing mapu, om xel yaleeng me neil, “Inye memo ti nu.” Om xel yaleeng me nyayek.
Ekom Yesu wo daing me neil wou xel, “Xam nale nimkanzek! Inye ay yo. Om xam seng gwaleeng.”
Petele neil elox bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wangwei inye wang nei, ond neil me a lak wou wang lek memiing on.”
Moxo neil, “Lam.” Woyom Petele teila veil bot, dom la lek memiing mapu me la wou Yesu.
Ekom moxo yei laweeng, moxo yaleeng mouyo, me di teila eivek manghembi, om taxe niseikeing, “Tambiy Ngandoung, vind ay!”
Lutika eno Yesu tatei mema la me vyex e. Moxo neil, “Wa xe wongeingis on nayaka. Wa laleim on wo yuw enva?”
Woyom luw lek la eivek bot, de laweeng on mey.
Woyom xel wei toundei eivek bot on wong lalo wou e, me neil, “Neing ayang wang on Anutu Neu Moux.”
Ka xel la nge loxalu, xel teila Genesaret.
Xel xomaxoneing wei beyeeng on woulek Yesu, xel wong qayeeng la wou xel xomaxoneing wei mindei paviy beyeeng dalus on. Xomaxoneing dalus on qou xel xe xel wei vanei yo me lam wou e
me tay wou e bei xel mou daxlek e xe teimb myasepu, me eti yeiw wei axlek e eno wo nimzalek.
